note: The 1952 Enchiridion gives Iesu at all three Agnus Dei responses. The Thesaurus reads Domine in the first and Iesu in the following two. Both concluding prayers appear in each source.

adjudicated.ruling: The 1952 Enchiridion prints obedientissime on p. 53. The Thesaurus gives oboedientissime, the spelling retained here.
The 1952 Enchiridion reads Iesu after parce nobis on p. 55, as in the selected text. The Thesaurus gives Domine here.
In the first concluding prayer the 1952 Enchiridion reads nunquam on p. 55. The Thesaurus gives numquam here. Both sources have numquam in the following prayer.
